jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

jobs.title: Solutions Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

Weâre building an AI scientist for our customers. We canât do that if we havenât built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. Solutions Delivery Manager works cross-functionally with Benchling's build organization, as well as across the CX departments, to develop robust solutions that can deliver value to our customers, while improving internal knowledge and productivity.

Chemistry is one of Benchling's newest and most exciting product areas â unlocking an entirely new group of companies, scientists, and science to be done on Benchling. This role will help navigate a budding product area through to market adoption, partnering closely with internal product, enablement, and delivery teams, while working directly with customers to build trust and help shape our vision in this space.

Successful Solutions Delivery Managers will harness the knowledge and experience Benchling has gained across thousands of customer engagements, and leverage previous and learned experience to serve as an expert across scientific domains and modalities served by Benchling. They will develop, and continuously improve our solutions as both the science and Benchling product capabilities evolve. A successful candidate will be comfortable working across teams and systems, often with no existing guidance or playbook, to deliver impactful solutions and value aligned with our department and team goals.

jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

jobs.title: Head of Compliance Product
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.

Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.

You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

  • Lead product for our agentic compliance programme: AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start.

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect.

  • Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways: Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with.

  • Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences.

 
 

What this role is not

  • Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme.

  • Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention.

  • Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems.

 
 

Who we're looking for

  • 10+ years building software products, including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you.

  • A genuine zero-to-one track record: an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on.

  • Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company.

  • Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • AI-native: AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role.

  • Deep executional rigour: you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line.

  • High self-sufficiency: you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn.

  • Continuous systems thinking: you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster.

  • A data-informed operating style: you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees.

  • Judgement under ambiguity: you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist.

  • Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments: you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality.

  • Restlessness about velocity and quality: you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested.

If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Risk and Controls Operations Associate

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Reporting: Chief Operating Officer

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that.

So far, we have raised £3.5 million in funding, secured direct regulatory approval from the FCA, and picked up two major awards in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) and Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN). Having launched on iOS - reaching 4,000+ total sign-ups - we have now just launched on Android, doubling our addressable market as we scale toward targets of 10,000 users, 100,000, and beyond.

Key Platform Traction:

  • 8,000+ trades processed

  • 2,500+ early supporters rewarded for their loyalty

  • 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • 150+ 5-star reviews

Our goal is straightforward: Think Options, Think Investa.

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

The Role

As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control.

This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody.

What the role involves

1. Risk & Control Operations

  • CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations.

  • CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed.

  • KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations.

  • Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews.

  • Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies.

2. Business Oversight & Governance Support

  • Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight.

  • Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules.

  • Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm.

  • Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support.

  • Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail.

Your Background

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience covering trade operations or controls support at a regulated firm, FinTech, investment platform, or broker.

  • Understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding CASS, Consumer Duty, Systems & Controls, and Anti-Money Laundering.

  • Direct experience executing CASS reconciliation workflows, client adoption, and trade surveillance.

  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and sound, practical judgement.

  • Technical proficiency in Office and Google-based software including excel, Google Sheets, Google Docs.

Desirable

  • Prior exposure to retail investment platforms, derivatives markets.

  • Experience using workflow tools like Jira or case management software.

  • Familiarity with third-party clearing integrations (e.g., Interactive Brokers) or regulatory reporting tools.

  • CISI or equivalent qualification regarding financial services, client assets, or regulatory modules.

  • Understanding of EU regulation.

What we offer

  • Career Ownership & Impact: You have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

  • Collaboration & Proximity: You work alongside our co-founders. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a voice in the product journey.

  • Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

  • Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company equity. Our success is your success.

 

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Competitive base salary - depending on experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.15% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by the staff. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
TL;DR – We’re looking for an exceptional Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

 

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

About the role

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production software

  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development

  • A track record of writing maintainable, well-tested code and owning what you build in production

  • Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

  • Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

  • Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

  • Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end-to-end ownership

Bonus if you’ve:

  • Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before

  • Led zero-to-one product development

  • Worked in a founding or early startup environment

 

What you’ll do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems

  • Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems

  • Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend

  • Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements

  • Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

  • Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries

  • Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks

  • Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

 

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Golang & Rust

  • Frontend: React, Typescript

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers

  • Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

 

How we hire

  1. Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.

  2. Complete a quick live coding exercise.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

  4. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.

 

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

How do you build a platform that works seamlessly across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud without compromising security or developer experience? Those are the kinds of problems you'll solve.

You'll define the technical direction for the platform that powers Lovable Enterprise—from cloud architecture and sandboxing to networking, encryption, and identity.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership. You'll help define a platform rather than inherit one. Many of the hardest architectural decisions haven't been made yet, giving you the opportunity to shape the foundation of Lovable Enterprise alongside engineering leadership.

You'll define the technical direction for the platform that lets enterprise customers run Lovable securely and at scale.

You'll spend your time writing software, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and working directly with customers on problems that don't have established playbooks. Examples include:

  • Designed and scaled distributed systems in production that are used by multiple teams.

  • Sandboxing and isolation (containers, microVMs, multi-tenant security).

  • Enterprise identity, networking and encryption (SSO/SCIM, KMS/BYOK, private networking).

  • Languages: Go, Rust, TypeScript

  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agents (Python) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Bliro:

  • The AI assistant for field sales

  • Takes desk work off sales reps' plates entirely, with more than one million customer touchpoints documented

  • Trusted by lighthouses of the German Mittelstand like igus, Lanxess and Brillux

  • Backed by 468 Capital, Lea Partners, Rockstart and more, with over €3M raised

  • See Bliro in action: https://bliro.io

Why We're Hiring This Role:

  • Our chat agent and our voice to voice phone agent process and document thousands of customer interactions a week for field sales teams. Every answer has to be right, fast and useful on the road.

  • Our backend engineers build the platform. We need a senior AI engineer who owns agent quality: what the agents say, how well they say it, and how we prove they got better.

  • You'll own prompting and context, model benchmarking for our use cases, evals, and the agent harness behind both agents. You join a small team of high performing specialists who own the core of our agents. This role is about orchestrating and evaluating models, not training them.

What You'll Do:

  • 30 Days: Map Bliro's chat and voice agents end to end. Partner with the backend engineers, review real user conversations, identify the biggest failure modes, and ship an initial improvement.

  • 60 Days: Own agent quality measurement. Build eval sets and metrics for our key use cases, benchmark models on quality, latency and cost, and ship a change with a measurable improvement against the baseline.

  • 90 Days: Establish a repeatable model for improving agent quality. Run evals on every prompt, model and harness change, turn real conversations into new test cases automatically, and set the longer term roadmap for agent quality.

Who You Are:

  • Evidence of ownership and shipping LLM agents to real users and proving with data that they got better. You can demonstrate excellence and pursued a technical major at one of the major technical universities like TUM, ETH, KIT, RWTH, EPFL, etc.

  • Strong Python and the ability to debug agent behavior across prompts, tools, context and model choice.

  • Hands on experience building eval pipelines, LLM judges and model benchmarks, with enough statistics to tell a real gain from noise.

  • A habit of reading raw conversations and turning what you find into test cases, fixes and clear priorities.

  • Deep curiosity and the ability to gather context quickly, form a clear point of view, and keep pace as models and the product evolve.

  • A low ego teammate who communicates clearly and owns outcomes. Familiarity with AI coding tools is expected; experience with the latest agent frameworks, realtime voice agents and multilingual agents is a plus.

  • This is a full time role. We prefer hybrid in Munich but are open to remote.

How We Work:

  • Ambition: We get better every day by being curious and bold.

  • Continuous improvement: Move fast and break things, but never the same thing twice.

  • It's our problem: We operate as one team. We share credit, own mistakes together, and support each other when things get hard.

  • Why not today? We value urgency and momentum. The fastest path to customer value usually wins.

  • Build something worthy of love: Craft matters. We aim to build products customers genuinely love.

Why Bliro:

  • Generational impact: Build the human interface for millions of field sellers

  • Ownership culture: Many of us are former founders

  • Forward thinkers: We are the world leader in privacy preserving transcription, we know how boundaries can be overcome

What We Offer:

  • Real stake: Strong base salary plus meaningful equity ownership

  • Time off: 30 days of PTO, so take what you need

  • Hybrid setup: Work from our office in the heart of Munich, right next to the Frauenkirche, or from home. We value outcomes, not attendance

  • More: Free meals and drinks, Deutschlandticket, best in class equipment, and Wellpass

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

Front has received numerous accolades, including a Certified Great Place to Work in 2026, Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025, Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023, #4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™ ,Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list, and Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List.

AI is transforming customer service at a pace the industry hasn’t seen before. Front is at the leading edge of that shift, with more than 9,000 companies worldwide, including CultureAmp, Hootsuite, and Y Combinator, already running their support operations on it.

We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to help close the gap between how Front is designed and how Front is built. Front has a mature, complex product surface with more than a decade of UI investment, a rich Figma library, and a large production codebase. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable in Figma and in frontend code, and who wants to turn design systems from static documentation into living, production-quality systems that help product teams move faster.

You’ll own the connective tissue between Design and Engineering: building reusable components, shaping design-system architecture, improving the fidelity between Figma and production, and creating the tooling, patterns, and practices that make high-quality UI easier to ship. You won’t just document the system — you’ll build it, ship it, evolve it, and help teams adopt it.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with high leverage across Product, Design, and Engineering. The right person brings strong frontend engineering judgment, excellent UI craft, deep design-systems experience, and the ability to influence teams without becoming a bottleneck.

What will you be doing?

  • Own and evolve Front’s design system across Figma, Storybook, and production code, helping create a clearer source of truth between design and engineering.

  • Build, refactor, and maintain reusable, accessible, well-documented UI components that product teams can confidently use across Front’s core surfaces.

  • Identify and reduce design/code drift across our existing component libraries, legacy UI patterns, and evolving Figma system.

  • Establish patterns, conventions, and guardrails that improve consistency, accessibility, maintainability, and developer experience.

  • Prototype new interaction patterns and reference implementations in code to help teams align quickly and de-risk complex product decisions.

  • Partner closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers to define what “great” looks like for complex workflows, edge cases, and enterprise-grade product experiences.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate prototyping, iteration, production changes, and system maintenance while applying strong judgment to the output.

What skills and experience do you need?

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building production frontend experiences, ideally in complex B2B SaaS, enterprise software, developer tools, or similarly deep product domains.

  • Strong frontend engineering skills with modern web technologies and component-based architecture. You do not need to have used Front’s exact stack, but you should be able to ramp quickly in a large, mature codebase.

  • High UI/UX craft and strong product taste. You can evaluate whether an interface is not only visually polished, but also usable, accessible, flexible, and maintainable.

  • Experience building or maintaining component libraries, Storybook documentation, visual regression workflows, design-token pipelines, Figma workflows/plugins, or similar design-engineering infrastructure.

  • Strong accessibility fundamentals, including semantic HTML, ARIA patterns, keyboard interaction models, focus management, and inclusive component states.

  • Strong communication skills. You can explain technical and design-system decisions clearly to both specialists and non-specialists.

  • A portfolio or body of work showing shipped design-engineering impact: production UI, component systems, prototypes, Storybook examples, design-system documentation, or code-backed product work.

Bonus points

  • Experience working on products with a large existing frontend surface area, multiple product teams, and a mature or evolving design system.

  • Experience in customer support, customer operations, collaboration software, internal tools, developer tools, or other workflow-heavy SaaS products.

  • Experience consolidating fragmented component libraries or aligning Figma libraries with production code.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or design tools to accelerate prototyping, refactoring, and product iteration.

What you’ll bring to Front

  • A systems mindset: you see patterns, edge cases, and long-term maintenance costs, not just individual screens.

  • A high craft bar: you care about the last 10% of interaction detail, visual polish, accessibility, and usability.

  • A builder’s bias: you prefer to make ideas real in code, learn from how they behave, and iterate quickly.

  • A collaborative approach: you raise the quality of work around you by making the right path easier for other designers and engineers.

  • Senior-level judgment: you can operate through ambiguity, prioritize high-leverage improvements, and sequence change in a way that teams can actually adopt

Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.

Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Role Description:
Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their
subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using
it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We
are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East.
The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they
are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home.
Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think
about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale.
We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather
than in a broad prospecting territory.
It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our
executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market.

Responsibilities:
• A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing
deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business.
• A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion.
• The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC,
commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay
accountable through launch.
• The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product
or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband
P&L.
• A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive
sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it.
• Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late.
• A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where
their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory.

Qualifications:
This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder
structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for
reflects that.
• A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence
of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the
buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many.
• Ownership of deals in the multi-million-dollar ACV range, with 9 to 24 month cycles, formal
procurement, and an established solution already in place.
• Fluency in ISP economics. ARPU and attach rates, churn and retention drivers, cost to serve,
contact volumes and handling time, truck roll avoidance, CPE fleet lifecycle and ODM relationships,
NPS. You should be able to build a credible business case yourself before a solutions engineer is in
the room.
• Experience winning business where the customer already had a solution in place, whether bought
or built in-house. That is a different commercial conversation, and we place real weight on it.

• Existing senior relationships across UK and Ireland ISPs, or a specific and realistic plan for building
them inside two quarters.
• MEDDPICC applied in practice rather than in theory. Expect to walk us through a live deal from your
current role against it.
• Comfort operating without a finished playbook. Our product moves, our commercial models evolve,
and parts of this territory are still being defined. You will be building as you sell.
• Consistent quota attainment, and the ability to explain honestly where you missed and why.
• Willingness to travel regularly across UK and Ireland, and occasionally across EMEA.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
jobs.description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission. 

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

What to know

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams. 

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

The company

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

A day in the life

  • Lead and inspire: Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.  
  • Create with purpose: Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
  • Accountability: Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity: Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

What we offer

  • Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days)
  • $1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent)
  • Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax)
  • Generous pension match via salary sacrifice 
  • Generous paid holiday schedule 
  • Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures
  • Group Income Protection (GIP)
  • Group Life Assurance (GLA)
  • Optional holiday travel insurance
  • Pre-tax season ticket loans
  • Cycle to work (up to £2000)
  • Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

The team

You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

Some things we're looking for

  1. 6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.
  2. Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.
  3. Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights. 
  4. Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work. 
  5. Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.
  6. Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.
  7. Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy. 
  8. An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.
  9. Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that. 
  10. Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.
  11. Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.
  12. A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we're always making progress.
  13. A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and  ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.
  14. Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don't think your current skill set checks every box, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.

Blue State is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible application and interview process. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a disability, including the use of AI tools throughout the hiring process, please contact us at subject line: Accommodation Request to get started.

Your privacy is important to us.  You can find out more information on how we handle your data for recruiting purposes in our Privacy Policy for Recruitment.

jobs.title: Content Strategist & AI Copy Lead
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Content Strategist & AI Copy Lead

Location: London, United Kingdom

About the role: 

As Content Strategist & AI Copy Lead, you'll own positioning, messaging, and copy across a B2B payments business where clarity, accuracy, and trust matter. You'll build and maintain the copy generation frameworks, prompts, and tone-of-voice guardrails that allow AI tools — including the Pencil platform — to produce on-brand first drafts at volume, and you'll bring the critical editorial eye to shape and improve what comes out.

You won't be starting from scratch. You'll work within an established content strategy and system, helping it evolve as new brand work lands and business priorities shift. As the studio matures through the year, you'll take on greater ownership of intake, briefing, and prioritisation — playing a central role in how the studio runs day to day. This is a senior role for someone who moves confidently between strategic thinking and hands-on craft without losing quality at either end.

What you will be doing: 

  • Own positioning, messaging frameworks, and campaign narratives for Client's products, propositions, and sectors — answering the strategic content question before production begins, so the studio can move at pace.
  • Write and edit high-quality copy across web, email, social, digital advertising, sales collateral, product datasheets, presentations, and video scripts.
  • Lead thought leadership content — foundational articles and their supporting social and digital assets — in line with the agreed content strategy.
  • Build and maintain copy generation frameworks in Pencil and other approved AI tools, including prompts, templates, tone-of-voice rules, and message libraries.
  • Review, direct, and refine AI-generated copy with a rigorous editorial eye — identifying errors, inconsistencies, and off-brand language, and correcting them through prompt refinement or direct editing.
  • Work with compliance, legal, and risk stakeholders to ensure content is clear, fair, and not misleading — and embed their requirements into copy frameworks from the outset.
  • Support PR with rapid-turnaround content and Sales Enablement with always-current messaging as new products, features, and sectors come online.
  • Write scripts and narratives for the Motion & Content Production Lead, and develop messaging for the studio's templates and collateral.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Brand, PR, Sales Enablement, and Internal Communications to plan and prioritise content against commercial priorities.
  • Run studio intake, briefing, and prioritisation with the Project Manager, taking full ownership as the studio's operations mature through the year.
  • Use content performance insight to refine messaging frameworks over time.
  • Share Gen AI learnings and techniques across the studio, contributing to a culture of continuous experimentation and improvement. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

Skills and experience

  • Proven experience as a senior copywriter, content strategist, or content lead in an agency, in-house team, or content studio.
  • Strong ability to develop positioning, messaging frameworks, and campaign narratives from complex product and business information.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills across long and short form — from thought leadership articles to headlines, emails, and social posts.
  • Experience building reusable content tools: tone-of-voice guides, message houses, prompt libraries, or content templates.
  • A critical editorial eye: able to assess AI-generated copy quickly and improve it through prompt refinement or direct editing — not simply approve it.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and turning competing requests into clear, prioritised content plans.
  • Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple requests at pace, including triaging briefs and managing stakeholder expectations.
  • Genuine interest in what AI can do for content and creativity, with awareness of the ethical and legal considerations involved.

Useful but not essential

  • Experience with Pencil or an equivalent AI creative platform (training on Pencil will be provided).
  • Background in financial services, payments, fintech, or B2B technology.
  • Familiarity with writing in a regulated environment, including financial promotions or Consumer Duty requirements.
  • Experience with SEO, content performance measurement, or content management systems.
  • Experience creating B2B sales enablement content.
  • Advanced use of Gen AI tools — such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini — to enhance copy quality and content output, including hands-on prompting, model selection, and workflow design.
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows for yourself and others to improve efficiency and output quality.
  • Ability to train others on effective AI tool use and share best practice across the team.
  • Agentic approach to complex, multi-step content challenges — breaking briefs into components and finding efficient, high-quality routes to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with rigorous human oversight and editorial judgement applied throughout.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer (Retail) to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us shape the strategic vision for retail delivery, building brand-new shopping experiences and unlocking emerging categories to scale our marketplace.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Retail team. Retail is a fast-growing, greenfield area for us beyond core restaurant and grocery delivery, helping people get almost anything delivered locally.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

Strategic Direction & Product Vision

  • Lead strategic design sprints to establish the foundation and execution plan for our 2027 product vision, defining how distinct retail categories and shopping formats feel.

  • Partner autonomously with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders as a trusted advisor to co-own the product roadmap and decide what we build and why.

Craft & Quality

  • Raise the design craft bar across the team by guiding team members, hosting critique sessions, and fostering a culture of high quality and detail.

  • Spot and resolve platform-wide systems challenges—such as accessibility, performance, and UI consistency—at scale across the ecosystem.

Culture & Leadership

  • Drive studio-wide initiatives that shape overall design culture, recruitment practices, and the integration of AI into design workflows.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • End-to-End Design Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of complex, ambiguous product initiatives from greenfield ideas to launch within fast-paced tech environments.

  • Strategic Influence: Proven ability to act as a strategic partner to senior leadership, shaping business strategy and navigating competing priorities.

  • Developing Talent: Demonstrated experience coaching and mentoring designers to level up their craft while supporting autonomous growth.

  • Clear Communication: Proven ability to articulate design rationale clearly to cross-functional stakeholders, from engineering leads to executive directors.

  • Technical Systems Fluency: Strong understanding of how design decisions interact with code, systems architecture, and engineering constraints.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It's no simple task, but it wouldn't be interesting if it was!

About the Role

Money is DoorDash's organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive Money Domain's Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain's strategy into executable technical programs. 
  • Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.
  • Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Money Domain (Financial Systems). You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end consumer, rider/ courier, and merchant experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.
  • Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.
  • Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. Whether the goal is expanding access to DoorDash logistics, improving delivery quality and reliability, enabling new partner use cases, or improving cost to serve, you will help teams stay focused on the technical work that matters most to the business.

Street Group is a fast-moving B2B SaaS business, grown in Manchester but on a UK-wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We're PE-backed and scaling fast with an ambitious growth plan, and we're looking for an FP&A Analyst to help us get there.


As we grow, our revenue streams are becoming more varied by the month. That means more reporting, more complexity, and a finance function that needs to proactively help drive growth.


This is an opportunity to help expand our FP&A function, you won't be slotting into a fixed process. You'll be shaping it while owning the data and supporting the models that feed our board packs and investor reporting.


If you want ownership early, enjoy explaining what the numbers mean as much as producing them, and already use AI to take the manual work out of finance, we think you might do great work here.


Why this role exists now


We're growing quickly, and our finance team is growing with us. As our revenue streams expand, so does the appetite for clear, timely insight from our board and investors. That's where you come in. Join us early, help shape how FP&A works here, and see your work make a real difference from day one.


The role

You'll work closely with our FP&A Lead and the wider finance team, owning the data behind our FP&A outputs and turning it into insight the business can act on.

Day-to-day, that means owning our performance trackers and reporting models, drafting the monthly board and management packs, and supporting VCP performance and reporting. You'll help implement new tools and own the data behind them, build dashboards to track commercial and financial performance, and reconcile data across multiple systems so everything stays accurate and consistent.

You'll also support three-statement modelling and our annual budget and rolling forecast cycles, and pick up ad hoc commercial insight and improvement projects as they come up. Throughout, you'll use Claude to automate routine reporting and modelling, so your time goes on the insight that matters.


Who we're looking for

  • 2-4 years in an FP&A, commercial finance or analytical role, and part-qualified or newly qualified (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).

  • A meticulous and detail-driven individual with a strict commitment to accuracy and precision in all financial modelling and reporting.

  • Experience building driver-based models for budgets and forecasts, and producing management information or board and management packs.

  • A solid understanding of double-entry and comfort with three-statement modelling.

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas and sensitivity and scenario modelling.

  • An AI-native mindset: you already use Claude, Copilot or a similar tool in your finance work, and you would rather simplify and automate a manual process than plough through it.

  • The ability to explain numbers in plain language to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Someone self-motivated and comfortable managing their own workload without close oversight.

  • SaaS, subscription or tech experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Time at a growing, PE-backed business would be particularly interesting to us.

Why you might not want to apply

  • We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won't be for everyone.

  • If you want clearly defined, settled role boundaries , ours are still forming and will keep evolving as we scale.

  • If you'd rather process numbers than own and explain them. This role is about the story behind the figures as much as the figures themselves.

  • If pace, ambiguity and shifting priorities aren't for you. We move quickly, and priorities change as the business grows.

Who are Street Group?

We're an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk, Spectre & Cortex, form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Why join Street Group?

£45,000 - £55,000, dependent on experience. Sometimes the right person is more or less experienced than we expected. If you think that might be you, please apply and let us know.
