jobs.title: Data analytics engineer
jobs.description:
Hybrid working one day per week in our London, Edinburgh or Bath office.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

Seccl is growing fast, and so is the opportunity to make better use of our data. Our Data Engineering team has built strong foundations for reliable, scalable data delivery, and we’re now expanding our capabilities to make that data more accessible, actionable, and valuable to our teams and clients.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You’ll use strong software engineering and data modelling practices to develop production-quality datasets, while working closely with stakeholders to understand how data can help solve real business problems.

You’ll also help us evolve how data moves through our platform, including opportunities to work with streaming and event-driven technologies as we move towards more timely and incremental data processing.

 

On a typical day you will be…

  • Designing, building, and maintaining robust data models using SQL and DBT, transforming complex source data into clear, reusable datasets for analytics and downstream consumers

  • Working with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, and client-facing teams to understand requirements, clarify business logic, and translate problems into scalable data solutions

  • Helping define and maintain consistent metrics, modelling standards, and analytical best practices across the business

  • Supporting our journey towards more real-time and incremental data processing, including working with technologies such as MongoDB change streams, Kafka, and AWS MSK

  • Helping teams become more self-sufficient with data by making datasets understandable, well documented, and easy to consume

You’ll be successful in this role if you…

  • Have strong SQL and data modelling skills and are comfortable transforming large, complex datasets into reliable, reusable analytical models

  • Have experience with Python and modern analytics engineering tooling such as DBT, including testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD practices

  • Are familiar with both relational and non-relational database architecture

  • Understand dimensional modelling and how to design datasets that are intuitive and effective for analytics, BI, and downstream data products

  • Have experience working with cloud data platforms and services, ideally within AWS

  • Ideally have experience with event-driven or streaming data architectures, particularly Kafka/AWS MSK, MongoDB change streams, CDC, or similar technologies

  • Have hands on experience working with an orchestration tool such as Airflow

  • Thrive in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, analysts, and client facing teams

  • Communicate clearly and can explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Take ownership of problems end-to-end, from understanding the requirement and designing the solution through to implementation, validation, documentation, and adoption

This role isn’t for you if:

  • You rely on heavily on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a freedom and ownership early on – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes

  • You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver

  • You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan, will writing offering via Octopus Legacy and Seccl invest (our own platform for you to manage your investments)

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts.

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 mins

  • First round - 40 mins

  • Second round - 60 mins

  • Bar raiser - 40 mins

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Architect - Tracking
jobs.description:
This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role.

Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream.

You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them.

It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code.

What you would own

Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation.

Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job.

Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing.

Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place.

Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles.

The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached.

What we are looking for

The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics.

On top of that:

  • Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability

  • Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

  • Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices

  • Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases

  • A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV

The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports leagues and federations. And you can size work honestly, state your confidence in it, and say what we should stop or delay.

What this role is not

Worth being direct about, because senior CV engineers are usually offered the other thing.

This is not a people management role. Nobody reports to you. Line management sits elsewhere and we are not planning to move it.

It is not project or delivery management either. Delivery Leads coordinate squad delivery across T&AO. You own technical direction and escalation, not sprint management.

You are not a Product Owner. Product sets the market and problem priorities, you work with them to define the solution.

You are not a Squad Tech Lead. Day-to-day technical leadership of squads sits with the Squad Tech Leads and Engineering Leads. You mentor them and step in on the complex and high-risk problems.

And you are not a gatekeeper for other value streams. You give them alignment and access to shared tracking IP. You do not own their roadmaps.

Value Stream - Tracking & Auto Officiating

About the Role

At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we're at the forefront of sports technology, developing the tracking and decision-making systems used across some of the world's biggest sporting events!

We're looking for a Computer Vision Engineer – Algorithms to join our Cricket team in Budapest. This role is ideal for someone with commercial or strong academic experience in computer vision who is excited by solving complex technical challenges and seeing their work used in live sporting environments.

You'll work on the development and enhancement of the computer vision algorithms that power our cricket solutions, contributing to technologies such as ball tracking, player tracking, and other advanced tracking systems used at the highest levels of the sport.

Working alongside experienced Computer Vision Engineers and Algorithm Specialists across the UK and Hungary, you'll help improve the accuracy, robustness, and performance of systems that operate in real time and under the pressures of live sport.

  • Developing and improving computer vision algorithms for cricket tracking systems.

  • Building and enhancing ball and player tracking solutions using multi-camera technology.

  • Contributing to multi-view geometry solutions to improve tracking accuracy.

  • Solving challenging problems around occlusion, recovery, and object tracking.

  • Optimising algorithms for performance, scalability, and reliability.

  • Enhancing mature computer vision systems already used in live production environments.

  • Investigating and resolving algorithmic accuracy and performance issues.

  • Collaborating with engineers across computer vision, software, and platform teams.

  • Experience developing or applying computer vision algorithms through commercial or academic projects.

  • Strong C++ programming skills and an interest in modern software development practices.

  • Understanding of computer vision fundamentals and image processing techniques.

  • Familiarity with multi-camera systems and associated computer vision challenges.

  • Experience using Git or other version control systems.

jobs.title: Head of Implementation
jobs.description:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of Implementation, you will build the foundations that let implementation scale: the operating model, the process and the standards we need to grow well beyond where we are today. Enterprise implementation is slow and manual almost everywhere, so you will rebuild ours around agents, which almost no delivery leader gets the chance to do on live enterprise builds. Through all of it, you own how our largest customers experience Ben, from the enterprise sales conversation through to a confident go-live.

Things you will be working on

  • Transform how we implement enterprise customers: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. Rebuild the operating model, the standards and the reusable components so we can take on far more without adding a person for every customer, and collapse the time it takes a customer to reach value.

  • Make implementation AI-native: our builds are technically complex (integrations, eligibility logic, huge volumes of data). jobs.title: Senior Manager Logistics (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

  • Develop and optimize processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

  • Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

  • Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

  • Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics processes right from the start.

Your Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in logistics or warehouse management, import/export or manufacturing operations

  • At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

  • Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

  • Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

  • Proven expertise in dangerous goods, German regulatory requirements and compliance, ideally combined with cleanroom logistics experience

  • A pragmatic leadership mindset, strategic thinking, and strong problem-solving as well as stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent German language skills (minimum: C1) and good English (minimum: B2)

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Can you picture yourself in this role and our company? Let's connect.

  • Du machst aus langweiligen Textwüsten kreativ aufgeladene, visuell überzeugende Präsentations-Slides.

  • Du kannst deine Gedanken und komplexe Inhalte klar, strukturiert und ansprechend visualisieren.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung von Workshops und Reporting-Unterlagen.

  • Du beobachtest den Markt, führst Wettbewerbs- und Trendmonitorings durch und bringst aktuelle Social-Media- & Design-Trends aktiv in deine Arbeitsweise ein.

  • Auch abseits von Rein-Design hast du Lust, dich proaktiv in angrenzende Themen (z. B. Social-Media-Strategien) einzubringen und mitzugestalten.


Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschrieben in einem Studium im Bereich Gestaltung, Kommunikationsdesign, Marketing, Kommunikation, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Fach (ab dem 3. Fachsemester).

  • Design ist deine absolute Kernkompetenz und Leidenschaft.

  • Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis und echtes Interesse für Social Media und schaust gerne über den reinen Design-Tellerrand hinaus.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Google Slides und PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Senior HR People & Talent Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du gewinnst die richtigen Menschen und übernimmst Verantwortung für alles, was danach kommt?
Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über eine Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Unsere Logistik sorgt täglich dafür, dass unsere Produkte zuverlässig bei ihnen ankommen. Dafür brauchen wir starke Mitarbeitende und eine Personalarbeit, die vorausdenkt, Entscheidungen voranbringt und im Alltag funktioniert.
Als Senior HR People & Talent Partner (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort in Lensahn. Du gewinnst neue Talente, begleitest Mitarbeitende über den gesamten Beschäftigungszeitraum und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei anspruchsvollen Personalentscheidungen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du HR-Prozesse und setzt Projekte eigenständig um.
Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in unserem Hamburger Office. Zweimal im Monat bist du vor Ort in Lensahn. Du bist Teil unseres HR-Teams und arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und unserem Head of Logistics zusammen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Recruiting ganzheitlich verantworten: Du steuerst die Personalgewinnung für Lensahn – von der vorausschauenden Bedarfsplanung über Stellenausschreibungen, aktive Kandidatenansprache und Interviews bis zur Einstellung.
  • Neue Recruiting-Wege erschließen: Du findest geeignete Kanäle für die Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender, setzt neue Maßnahmen um und entwickelst eine verlässliche Bewerberpipeline. Dabei behältst du Bewerberqualität und Besetzungsgeschwindigkeit im Blick.
  • Führungskräfte als Sparringspartner unterstützen: Du erkennst personellen Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig, gibst klare Empfehlungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit COO und Head of Logistics pragmatische Lösungen für den Lageralltag.
  • Employee Relations aktiv gestalten: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte, klärst Personalfragen und begleitest auch anspruchsvolle Gespräche und Konfliktsituationen souverän.
  • Arbeitsrechtliche Personalthemen steuern: Du ordnest Sachverhalte ein, bereitest erforderliche Maßnahmen vor und setzt sie in Abstimmung mit der Head of HR um. Dazu gehören Veränderungen im Arbeitsverhältnis, der Umgang mit Pflichtverletzungen und die professionelle Begleitung von Trennungsprozessen.
  • Verträge und Fristen im Griff behalten: Du erstellst und koordinierst Arbeitsverträge, Verlängerungen, Zusatzvereinbarungen und weitere Personaldokumente. Du sorgst dafür, dass anstehende Entscheidungen frühzeitig vorbereitet und relevante Fristen eingehalten werden.
  • Personio und digitale Personalakten aufbauen: Du strukturierst die Personalverwaltung für Lensahn in Personio, sorgst für vollständige Unterlagen und aktuelle Stammdaten und etablierst verlässliche digitale Abläufe.
  • HR-Projekte vorantreiben: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und verantwortest größere standortbezogene Projekte – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Dazu gehören beispielsweise ein strukturiertes Onboarding, die Digitalisierung von Personalprozessen und einheitliche Standards für die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR und Logistik.
  • Den gesamten Mitarbeiterzyklus begleiten: Du stellst sicher, dass vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt alle personellen und administrativen Schritte ineinandergreifen und das Offboarding vollständig abgeschlossen wird.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung im operativen HR-Management mit eigenständiger Verantwortung für Recruiting, Personalbetreuung und arbeitsrechtliche Themen.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement, Wirtschaftsrecht, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.
  • Nachweisbare Recruiting-Erfolge, idealerweise bei der Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender in Logistik, Lager, Produktion oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und praktische Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Personalfällen. Du kannst Handlungsmöglichkeiten bewerten und erkennst, wann eine zusätzliche rechtliche Prüfung erforderlich ist.
  • Erfahrung darin, Führungskräfte zu beraten, klare Empfehlungen auszusprechen und schwierige Personalgespräche professionell zu führen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Umsetzung von HR-Projekten und im Aufbau funktionierender Personalprozesse.
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Personio oder einem vergleichbaren HR-System sowie hohe Sorgfalt bei Verträgen, Daten und Dokumentation.
  • Eigeninitiative und einen hohen Anspruch an deine Ergebnisse: Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern erkennst Handlungsbedarf, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Themen verbindlich zum Abschluss.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung bis ins operative Detail zu übernehmen – vom Recruiting-Konzept bis zur vollständigen Personalakte.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Bereitschaft, zweimal im Monat unseren Standort in Lensahn zu besuchen.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Ein eigener Verantwortungsbereich: Du gestaltest die Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort und beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie das Team wächst und zusammenarbeitet.
  • Eine Rolle mit Substanz: Du verbindest Recruiting, Employee Relations, Arbeitsrecht und HR-Projekte und begleitest Themen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit und kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und dem Head of Logistics zusammen.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum mit sichtbaren Ergebnissen: Du etablierst neue Recruiting-Wege, verbesserst Abläufe und entwickelst Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum Schritt halten.
  • Office First: Wir setzen auf persönliche Zusammenarbeit und kurze Abstimmungswege vor Ort. Dein fester Arbeitsplatz ist in unserem Hamburger Office. Zweimal im Monat bist du an unserem Lagerstandort in Lensahn, um eng mit den Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden zusammenzuarbeiten.

Formance builds programmable financial infrastructure. Our open-source ledger helps engineering teams model, track, and reconcile money movements across financial products, from payment platforms to fintech applications and digital-asset businesses.

Financial infrastructure requires precision. Teams need to understand where money is, how it moves, and whether their systems reflect what actually happened. We build the tools to help them answer those questions.

YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with a strong technical foundation and experience in fintech or payments to join our team.

You’ll work with prospective customers to understand their architecture, map their financial flows, and demonstrate how Formance fits their requirements. You’ll partner closely with our sales, product, and engineering teams throughout the evaluation process.

This role combines technical depth with commercial judgment. You should be comfortable building a proof of concept, discussing architectural tradeoffs with an engineer, and explaining the business implications to a founder.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead technical discovery with engineering and product teams to understand their financial workflows, constraints, and evaluation criteria.

  • Build tailored demos and proofs of concept using Formance’s APIs and tooling.

  • Partner with sales to connect technical capabilities to business needs and move opportunities forward.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure. You understand how money moves through a financial product and the operational challenges involved.

  • A strong technical foundation. You can work with APIs, read and write code, debug integrations, and reason about data models and system architecture.

  • Experience working directly with customers, through solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or an engineering role with significant customer exposure.

Useful additional experience

  • Working with ledgers, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, or payment orchestration.

  • Supporting technical evaluations for API-first or developer-facing products.

  • Building financial workflows involving multiple currencies, payment providers, or digital assets.

WHY JOIN FORMANCE?

You’ll work directly with teams building financial products and help them make consequential infrastructure decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

  • Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  2. Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.

  3. Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.

  4. Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

jobs.title: (Senior) Go to Market Scaling Manager - Germany (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the (Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential.

  • You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero.
  • You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it.
  • You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running.
  • You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite.
  • You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements.
  • You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action.
  • You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving.
  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy.

Dein Profil

  • You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry.
  • You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance.
  • You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end.
  • You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market.
  • You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy.
  • You are comfortable working closely with Tech, Sales and Marketing teams and fluent in both sales/marketing and technology language, translating technical trade-offs into business decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements, without needing someone else to broker the conversation.
  • You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates.
  • You are native in German and fluent in English (C1/C2), written and verbal.
  • Knowledge of and experience in the German energy market is clearly a plus, but not a must.

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

jobs.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Technologie die bewegt. Ein Umfeld, in dem du wachsen kannst.

Seit über 20 Jahren gestalten wir bei tecRacer die Cloud-Welt mit. Als führender AWS Premier Tier Services Partner in Deutschland arbeiten wir an anspruchsvollen Cloud-Projekten, entwickeln innovative Lösungen und teilen eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Technologie. Was uns dabei mindestens genauso wichtig ist wie technologische Exzellenz? Wie wir zusammenarbeiten.

Bei uns zählen gute Ideen mehr als Hierarchien. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und echten Gestaltungsspielraum – und auf ein Umfeld, in dem du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Klare Karrierepfade, regelmäßiges Feedback, individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und eine transparente Fair-Pay-Struktur schaffen dafür den Rahmen.

Gemeinsam liefern, statt in Silos denken.

Unsere Projekte verstehen wir als gemeinsame Verantwortung. Deshalb arbeiten unsere Consultants und Developers in einem übergreifenden Delivery Team zusammen: Wissen, Erfahrung und unterschiedliche Perspektiven kommen dort zusammen, wo sie den größten Impact haben. Statt starrer Teamgrenzen setzen wir auf Zusammenarbeit über Projekte und Fachbereiche hinweg.

Dabei hast du trotzdem eine feste Führungskraft an deiner Seite, die dich kennt, deine Entwicklung begleitet und gemeinsam mit dir auf deine nächsten Schritte schaut.

Über die Stelle

Gestalte unser AWS-Partnerökosystem aktiv mit - entwickle gemeinsam mit AWS und unserem Partner-Ökosystem neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und bringe sie erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Dein Fokus liegt dabei besonders auf Net-New- und Greenfield-Kunden im DACH-Raum.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust starke Beziehungen zu AWS und weiteren Technologiepartnern auf und entwickelst daraus neue Kunden- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst partner- und AWS-generierte Opportunities und verantwortest diese vom Erstkontakt bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Account- und Opportunity-Pläne und treibst Co-Sell-Aktivitäten aktiv voran.
  • Du überführst Partnerkampagnen, Events und gemeinsame Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten in qualifizierte Sales Pipeline.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing und Delivery zusammen und sorgst für transparentes Pipeline Management und verlässliche Forecasts.

Stellenanforderungen

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in Partner Sales, Channel Sales, Business Development oder Consultative B2B Sales, idealerweise im IT-, Cloud- oder Technologieumfeld.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Partnerbeziehungen und partnergetriebenen Sales Opportunities, idealerweise mit Technologieanbietern, Solution Providern oder Channel-Partnern.
  • Gutes Verständnis von Co-Sell-, Partner- und Go-to-Market-Modellen sowie Erfahrung mit CRM, Pipeline Management und Forecasting.
  • Eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche und kommerziell geprägte Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Net-New Business.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1) sowie Bereitschaft zu ca. 20–30 % Reisetätigkeit

Das wäre schön, ist aber kein Muss:

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Partner- oder Channel-Programmen in einem Technologie- oder Consulting-Unternehmen.
  • Erfahrung mit dem AWS-Ökosystem und AWS-Partnerprogrammen.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit kommerziellen Partnermodellen, Business Cases, Pricing oder Vertrags- und Verhandlungsthemen.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Sales oder einem verwandten Bereich – alternativ ist für uns auch vergleichbare praktische Berufserfahrung relevant.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Und weil gute Arbeit mehr braucht als spannende Projekte, schaffen wir Rahmenbedingungen, die zu unterschiedlichen Lebensentwürfen passen.

  • 🚀 Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung - bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv mit.
  • ☁️ Ein starkes technisches Umfeld - arbeite mit erfahrenen AWS- und Cloud-Expert:innen und lerne voneinander.
  • 📈 Klare Entwicklungsperspektiven - mit Karrierepfaden, regelmäßigem Feedback sowie gezielter fachlicher und persönlicher Weiterentwicklung.
  • 💰 Fair Pay - mit einer transparenten und nachvollziehbaren Vergütungsstruktur.
  • 🕒 Flexible Arbeitszeiten - damit Arbeit und Privatleben gut zusammenpassen.
  • 🏡 Hybrides Arbeiten - mit Flexibilität und gleichzeitig Raum für persönlichen Austausch.
  • 🚆 Deutschland Ticket - für deine berufliche Mobilität.
  • 🚲 JobRad - für alle, die lieber auf zwei Rädern unterwegs sind.
  • 🛡️ Betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenzusatzversicherung - weil Benefits auch langfristig einen Unterschied machen dürfen.
  • 🎉 Regelmäßige Team-Events - für Austausch, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und Zeit miteinander abseits des Projektalltags.

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,
wellness and self-care

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.

Commercial Growth
  • Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.
  • Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.
  • Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.

    • Relationship Building
  • Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.
  • Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.
  • Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.
  • Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
  • Collaboration  - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
  • Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.
    •  
  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 

    • What we are looking for
  • Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
  • Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities
  • Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
  • Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
  • Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve
  • Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred
  • Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills
  • Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required
  • Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach

    • Added Bonus
  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
    •  
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

    • Interview Process
  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)
  • Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.
    •  
    We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks. 
     
  • Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe
    • Inclusive workforce
     
    At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
     
    We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
     
    We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
     
    If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

jobs.description:
Help us build the future of public administration!

Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 800 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region.

With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows.

Tasks

Your role

As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across our product, integration platform and production infrastructure.

Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you will set technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and help other engineers deliver independently. You will remain close to code and production without becoming the bottleneck for every difficult problem.

Your responsibilities

  • Evolve the architecture of Ayunis Core across frontend, backend, agent runtime, identity, permissions and extension interfaces.
  • Own the technical direction of our infrastructure, including deployments, reliability, observability, security and incident readiness.
  • Build stable APIs, SDKs and reusable integration patterns for external systems such as document management systems and identity providers.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed, simplicity and long-term maintainability.
  • Work with Product and customer-facing teams to turn recurring needs into reusable product capabilities.
  • Collaborate with open-source contributors, software vendors and integration partners.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Experience operating at Staff, Principal or a comparable level in a production software environment.
  • Strong backend and systems architecture skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with agent runtimes like LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Mastra or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with sovereign infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, scaling, observability and security.
  • Experience designing APIs and integrations, such as OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, synchronization or event-driven systems.
  • The ability to move between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation and debugging.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you judge technical decisions by their effect on reliability, delivery speed and customer value.
  • The ability to set technical direction and lead engineers without relying on formal authority.
  • An interest in using and systematically improving AI-assisted software development.
  • Confident communication in German and English.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose, Hetzner, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry and multiple LLM providers.

No LangChain though – we've built our agent orchestration from the ground up.

You'll lead threat modelling and design review with product teams, build the tooling and patterns that make secure codet, and find and fix the vulnerabilities that slip through.   • Securing our agentic and AI surfaces, from prompt injection and tool boundaries to delegated credentials and tenant-scoped access, and proving the controls hold under adversarial testing

  • Working as an embedded, trusted partner to product teams, SRE, detection and response, the data platform team, and the MystraAI / ML team, unblocking rather than gating

jobs.description:
About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

  • Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

     

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

  • Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

  • Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

  • The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

  • Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

  • Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

  • A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

  • Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Northern Europe Sales Leader to own and scale HappyRobot's commercial business across the UK, France, Germany and the Nordics. You will build and lead a team of enterprise sellers, set the sales culture, and run the region with rigor on forecast, pipeline and execution, while engaging directly with C-level buyers. You will report to the President of EMEA & APAC Sales and work as a peer of our Southern Europe Sales Leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Commercial Leadership - Oversee commercial activity and sales operations across Northern Europe, owning the regional revenue number.

  • Team Building & Management - Hire, onboard, coach and manage a team across the UK, France and Germany, and build a high-performance sales culture.

  • Forecast & Pipeline Rigor - Run forecasts, pipeline reviews and deal reviews with discipline, using data to drive decisions and hold the team accountable.

  • Executive Engagement - Engage customers and prospects at CXO level, and support your team on strategic enterprise deals and complex negotiations.

  • Market Development - Define and execute the go-to-market plan for each country, from target accounts to sales motion, adapting to local market dynamics.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Customer Success and Product to connect the field with the business and deliver tailored solutions.

  • Coaching & Performance - Develop your team through hands-on coaching, deal support and clear feedback, and manage performance and conflict constructively.

  • Market Insights - Stay on top of industry trends, competitor activity and market shifts, and feed them back into strategy and product.

Must Have

  • Proven experience selling technology, SaaS or AI solutions to enterprise customers.

  • Track record of leading sales teams and consistently meeting or exceeding targets, with large ACV deals.

  • Strong sales management skills: forecasting, pipeline management and deal reviews.

  • Established access to CXO / CSO-level buyers, preferably with existing market contacts in the UK.

  • Proven people management skills: building, coaching and scaling teams, including conflict management and resolution.

  • Analytical, data-driven and numbers-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Executive presence and strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Background in or close to HappyRobot's space (AI, voice, automation, logistics or enterprise software).

  • Experience selling across multiple European markets.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Extreme Ownership

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages — generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those. The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development. You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training. Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Model work: Post-train or ablate a GAIA rig-transfer or pose-transfer checkpoint (NVS warp, calibration/intrinsics, shortcut/distillation). Inspect failures: black margins, odometry bias, flickering, wrong curvature column.

  • Generation at scale: Kick off SDS / Flyte jobs for tens of thousands of segments; debug GPU capacity, KV cache, DDIM step count, MCAP/delta-table correctness.

  • Landing in training: Binarise synthetic into a corpus-compatible table, wire sampling hooks, train RL and read suite + on-road diffs.

  • Capability expansion: Pose-transfer ELK/AEB sets, dashcam→Alpha3, or a new OEM rig (Nissan Proto 2.1, Gen3, BMW).

  • Cross-team: Driving-model owners on mix ratios, closed-loop/eval on whether generated MCAPs are usable as suites.

  • Paper / research alignment: Video generation, novel-view / camera transfer, flow-matching / distillation, data-centric training — only insofar as it changes a checkpoint or a mix we ship.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: rig transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).

  • Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.

  • Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact — including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.

  • Diagnose and fix geometry, calibration, and controllability failures (intrinsics/extrinsics, NVS warps, odometry/curvature, flickering, camera-layout artefacts) that determine whether generated video is training-grade.

  • Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (shortcut, distillation, KV cache, step count), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.

  • Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).

  • Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • 4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and shipping neural nets, not only operating data platforms.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch (or equivalent); comfort with GPU training, debugging, and reading model code.

  • Hands-on experience with video, generative, or world models (diffusion / flow-matching / autoregressive video, novel-view synthesis, neural rendering, or similar).

  • Working knowledge of cameras and 3D geometry (multi-camera rigs, intrinsics/extrinsics, warps/reprojection) and why they break generation or downstream training.

  • Evidence of taking generated or simulated data into a trained downstream model and measuring impact (mix, ablations, failure analysis).

  • Ability to operate generation or training at real scale (multi-GPU jobs, workflow orchestration, large video artefacts) and to make that path reliable.

  • Collaborative, experimental working style with researchers and platform engineers; you will own a capability, not a ticket queue.
